content.text: {"id": "mm6511a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "table 2", "q": "1.65 (1.31–2.08)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Risk for becoming a case was higher among those who sat in the bleachers for ≥2 hours"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among respondents, 242 (32%) met the case definition."}, {"loc": "table 1", "q": "225 (93)"}]}, {"v": "continuous", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Affected persons spent more time in the gymnasium (mean = 5 hours) than nonaffected persons (mean = 3 hours) (p<0.01)."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Acute eye symptoms reported included burning eyes (93%), red eyes (86%), tearing eyes (76%), and foreign body sensation (74%)"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Affected persons spent more time in the gymnasium (mean = 5 hours) than nonaffected persons (mean = 3 hours) (p<0.01)."}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "0.66 (0.49–0.89)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "outbreak investigation", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "a cohort study was conducted to evaluate the 2011 cluster of 242 persons"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "A case-series investigation was conducted to evaluate the 2013 cluster of 20 persons"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Because event attendee registration information was available, a cohort study was conducted to evaluate the 2011 cluster of 242 persons"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Finally, because no asymptomatic exposed persons were identified for the 2013 event, measures of risk could not be calculated."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
